stories.title: PM Modi questions India Inc on wages, jobs and quality at FICCI
factBox: On 19 Nov 2026, at FICCI's centenary AGM in New Delhi, PM Modi asked whether companies raised salaries or hiring after the base corporate tax was cut from 30% to 22% and income up to ₹12 lakh was made tax-free.
He told industry not to treat 140 crore Indians as an 'assured market' for less than 'export quality' goods, and asked whether it had any plan to use India's new free trade agreements.
He invited suggestions on further reforms, calling industry 'my true friends'; on 20 Nov the Congress said the speech showed he was 'rattled' by the thought of soon becoming an 'outgoing PM'.

stories.title: Odisha evacuates over a lakh as Cyclone Akvan nears Gopalpur
factBox: On 19 Nov 2026, IMD said Severe Cyclonic Storm Akvan would cross the coast close to east of Gopalpur by noon on 20 Nov, with winds of 90–100 kmph gusting to 110 kmph.
Odisha had moved nearly 50,000 people by Thursday morning and more than 1 lakh, including close to 10,000 pregnant women, by the afternoon; CM Mohan Charan Majhi set a 'zero casualty' target.
Akvan made landfall near Gopalpur on 20 Nov and weakened; Odisha Disaster Management Minister Suresh Pujari said no major damage or loss of life had been reported.

stories.title: Coal India, ReNew among four firms get rare-earth magnet scheme LoIs
factBox: On 19 Nov 2026, Heavy Industries Minister H.D. Kumaraswamy handed letters of intent to Coal India, Prozeal Green Energy, ReNew and Midwest Energy under the ₹7,280-crore rare-earth permanent magnet scheme.
The scheme targets 6,000 tonnes a year of sintered magnet capacity, with ₹6,450 crore in sales-linked incentives over five years and ₹750 crore in capital subsidies.
China made 94% of the world's sintered permanent magnets in 2024 (IEA); the same day, a ₹3,435-crore payment-security portal covering 38,000+ PM-eBus Sewa electric buses was launched.

stories.title: India–Japan 2+2 in Tokyo flags weaponised supply chains
factBox: India and Japan held their fourth 2+2 Foreign and Defence Ministerial Meeting in Tokyo on 19 Nov 2026, with S. Jaishankar and Rajnath Singh meeting Toshimitsu Motegi and Shinjiro Koizumi.
Jaishankar flagged 'a growing tendency to weaponise connectivity, resources, services, supply chains and market shares'.

The ministers welcomed a letter of intent under which Japan's Self-Defence Forces will, for the first time, conduct live-fire training, including with surface-to-ship missiles, at Indian firing ranges.

scripts.topic: Tax cut aaya, appraisal kahan hai? PM ka FICCI fact-check

segments.line:
[SFX: polite applause that suddenly stops]

Namaste, main Reema, aur yeh hai The Late Edit. Aaj FICCI ke centenary convention mein Prime Minister ne India Inc se seedha poocha: 'Have you increased the salaries of your employees?' Aur phir khud hi bole, 'I know you won't applaud.' Socho. Sau saal purani industry body, aur hall mein pehli baar kisi ne appraisal ki baat ki... aur woh bhi HR ne nahi, PMO ne. Pehle facts. Opinions baad mein.

[GRAPHIC: FACT BOX — Sources: The Hindu, The Hindu BusinessLine, The New Indian Express]

Teen facts. Ek: aaj, 19 November ko, New Delhi mein FICCI ke centenary AGM mein PM Modi ne poocha ki base corporate tax 30% se 22% hone aur ₹12 lakh tak ki income tax-free hone ke baad, kya companies ne salaries ya hiring badhayi. Do: unhone kaha ki 140 crore Indians ko 'assured market' mat samjho, jahan 'export quality' se kam kuch bhi bik jaaye, aur poocha ki naye FTAs ka faayda uthane ka plan kahan hai. Teen: unhone industry ko 'my true friends' bolke aur reforms ke suggestions maange; aur 20 November ko Congress ne kaha ki PM 'outgoing PM' banne ke khayal se 'rattled' hain.

[GRAPHIC: 'HOW DID WE GET HERE?' — rewind effect]

Chaliye, rewind karte hain.

August 2013. Morgan Stanley India ko 'Fragile Five' economies mein daalta hai. Aaj PM ne yahi phrase yaad dilaya, ki hum 'fragile five' se fastest-growing major economy bane. Fair point, is pe main argue nahi karungi. Bas dhyaan rakhiye: GDP ka tez hona aur salary ka tez hona, do alag cheezein hain.

25 September 2014. Make in India launch hota hai. Target: manufacturing ka GDP share 25%, 2022 tak, aur 10 crore manufacturing jobs. [PROP: Reema ek sealed envelope uthati hai — 'APPRAISAL LETTER: INDIAN WORKER'] Yeh hai Indian worker ka appraisal letter. Har milestone pe kholenge. [kholti hai] 'Next year.' Theek hai.

20 September 2019. Goa mein Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman ordinance laati hain: base corporate tax 30% se 22%, naye manufacturing units ke liye 15%. Shart ek hi thi: 22% unke liye jo exemptions aur incentives claim nahi karengi. Jobs ki koi shart nahi thi. Logic simple tha: tax bachega, investment aayega, jobs aayengi. [envelope kholti hai] 'Next year.'

11 November 2020. Cabinet 10 sectors ke liye ₹1.46 lakh crore ka PLI approve karti hai; total ho jaata hai 14 sectors, ₹1.97 lakh crore. Commerce ministry ka Parliament answer: August 2024 tak 9.5 lakh se zyada employment. Achha number hai. Bas Make in India ke 10 crore jobs wale sapne ke saamne rakhiye, toh 1% bhi nahi. [envelope] 'Next year.'

Beech mein ek data point: Economic Survey 2024-25 ke mutabik 2023-24 mein India Inc ka profit 15 saal ke high pe tha. Profits 22.3% badhe. Employment? 1.5%.

1 February 2025. Budget: ₹12 lakh tak ki income pe zero income tax. Relief real hai. Par yeh relief government ne diya, employer ne nahi. Aur aaj PM ne isi relief ka hawala dekar poocha, 'Did you increase your employees' salaries or hire more staff?'

Aur aaj, 19 November 2026. FICCI centenary. PM Gandhi ji ko yaad karte hain: 'In 1930, Gandhi came to you and said exactly this.' Aur poochte hain: 'Is this your success or your failure?' [Reema envelope ulta karti hai, ek sticky note girta hai] Is baar sticky note pe likha hai: 'Modi ji, you do it, we'll watch.' Aur yeh line maine nahi likhi. PM ne khud quote ki, industry ka attitude samjhane ke liye.

[GRAPHIC: split screen — OFFICIAL CLAIM vs DATA]

Official claim: India 'fragile five' se fastest-growing major economy bana, aur World Bank report ke hawale se PM ne kaha 12–13 saal mein 50 crore log poverty se bahar aaye.

[GRAPHIC: CHART — Regular salaried avg monthly earnings: ₹16,538 (Jul–Sep 2017) → ₹21,103 (Apr–Jun 2024) | ~3.5% a year vs 4.9% avg inflation | Source: MoSPI via The New Indian Express]

Ab chart. Statistics ministry ki October 2025 report, jaisa New Indian Express ne quote kiya: regular salaried worker ki average monthly earning ₹16,538 se ₹21,103 hui. Saal ka lagbhag 3.5%. Usi period mein inflation average 4.9%. Matlab salary slip badhi, thaali chhoti hui. Yeh chart nahi hai, yeh EMI ka confession hai.

[GRAPHIC: manufacturing share of total GVA — 17.2% (2013-14) → 17.5% (2023-24), dotted line at 25% target | Source: PIB]

Aur manufacturing ka share? Sarkaar ke apne PIB data mein total GVA ka 17.2% tha 2013-14 mein, aur 17.5% 2023-24 mein. Das saal, 0.3 percentage point. Target tha 25%.

Toh affected kaun? Woh salaried worker jiski salary inflation se peeche hai. Woh youth jo factory job dhoondh raha hai. Aur woh consumer jise 'export quality' ka sticker dekh ke samajh aata hai ki baaki maal kis quality ka hai.

Who pays, who benefits, who is accountable? Tax cut ka bill exchequer ne bhara, profit companies ko mila, aur accountability ping-pong ball ban gayi. PM ne industry ko point kiya. Congress president Kharge ne X pe likha, 'He has woken up after 12 years.' Jairam Ramesh ne kaha PM wahi bol rahe hain jo Congress ke 2024 manifesto, Nyay Patra, mein tha. Note kar lijiye: manifesto likhna aur policy chalana alag cheezein hain, aur yeh baat har party pe laagu hoti hai. Fair rehne ke liye: Economic Affairs Secretary Anuradha Thakur ne usi subah industry se wage stagnation address karne ko kaha tha. Government ke andar bhi yeh baat ab chhupi nahi hai. Problem maanna pehla step hai. Doosra step government ka bhi hai.

SIDDHARTH: Reema ji, ek baat maaniye. Tax cut ordinance se ho jaata hai, naukri ordinance se nahi aati. Companies tab hire karti hain jab demand ho. Aur PLI ne electronics mein kaam kiya hai. Yeh aapka favourite editorial bhi maanta hai.

REEMA: Maanti hoon. New Indian Express kehta hai PLI electronics mein achha chala, textiles aur food processing mein slow. Lekin Siddharth, demand bhi tab aati hai jab salary badhti hai. Yeh murgi-anda wala problem hai.

SIDDHARTH: Toh murgi kaun hai, sarkaar ya industry?

REEMA: Jo bhi ho, anda worker ki thaali tak nahi pahunch raha.

SIDDHARTH: [muskuraate hue] Aapke charts mein meri daadi ke achaar se zyada masala hai.

REEMA: Aur aapke muhavaron mein data se zyada ghee. Par ek baat pe agreement: quality. 140 crore logon ko 'export quality' se kam kuch nahi milna chahiye.

SIDDHARTH: Is pe mera poora samarthan.

[GRAPHIC: 'WHAT NOW?']

Toh kya badalna chahiye?

Ek: tax relief ko outcomes se jodiye. Agar 22% wala rate investment aur jobs ke liye tha, toh sarkaar aur industry dono saal-dar-saal publicly bataayein: kitni hiring hui, kitni wage growth hui. Bina data ke 'friendship' sirf greeting card hai.

Do: PLI ka report card. Labour-intensive sectors jaise textiles aur food processing mein scheme slow hai, aur NIE ke mutabik wajah hai raw material costs aur eligibility bars. Inhe theek kariye, kyunki jobs wahin hain.

Teen: FTA ka homework. PM ne poocha, 'Have you made any plans to seize the opportunity?' Fair sawaal. Lekin chhote MSME ke paas na testing lab hai, na foreign distributor. Industry chambers ko apne chhote members ke liye standards aur export support ka kaam karna hoga, sirf Budget wishlist nahi.

Aap kya kar sakte hain? Apni salary slip ko inflation se compare kariye. Ghar pe apna 3.5 vs 4.9 wala chart banaiye. Kharidte waqt 'export quality' ke sticker pe mat jaiye, warranty aur standards dekhiye, aur quality kharab ho toh complaint kariye. Aur apne MP se poochiye: jo sawaal PM ne industry se poocha, wohi sawaal government ke apne 25% target se kab poocha jaayega?

Kya dekhna hai: Budget aa raha hai, aur NIE ke mutabik industry phir poochegi ki sarkaar uske liye kya kar sakti hai. Dekhiye ki FICCI aur baaki chambers wages aur hiring pe koi commitment laate hain ya nahi. Aur jo 'true friends' suggestions bhejenge, unmein worker ki salary ka zikr hoga ya nahi.

[PROP: the APPRAISAL LETTER envelope, ab giant size mein]

Toh aakhri baar, yeh appraisal letter. 2014: 'next year.' 2019: 'next year.' 2020: 'next year.' Aaj Prime Minister ne khud industry se poocha ki letter kab aayega. [kholti hai, padhti hai] 'Your feedback is valuable to us. Please write openly, without hesitation.' [beat] Achha. Toh ab HR bhi PMO se copy-paste kar raha hai.

Sach yeh hai: jab Prime Minister aur Opposition dono ek hi baat bol rahe hon, ki wages nahi badhe, toh bahas is pe honi chahiye ki ab karna kya hai. Is pe nahi ki pehle kisne kaha.

Aaj kaun jeeta? App mein vote kariye. Good night, aur apni EMI check kar lijiye.

scripts.topic: Cyclone Akvan: Odisha ne hawa haraayi, ab file ki baari

segments.line: Ek lakh se zyada log ghar chhod ke nikle, aur yeh achhi khabar hai.
[GRAPHIC: FACT BOX] Cyclone Akvan: 20 November, Gopalpur ke paas landfall forecast, 90–100 kmph hawa. Odisha ne 1 lakh+ log shift kiye. Landfall ke baad badi damage ya maut report nahi hui.

Pehle facts. Odisha ne sirf log shift nahi kiye. Reservoirs pehle khaali kiye, ghat roads barricade kiye, anti-snake venom tak pre-position kiya, har district ko ₹1 crore diya. [GRAPHIC: evacuees — subah ~50,000, dopahar 1 lakh+] Yeh chart state capacity ka hai, aur credit banta hai. Ab who pays? NIE ke mutabik Akvan 24 din mein teesra cyclone tha jisne Odisha ko dhamkaaya. Naveen Patnaik ne yaad dilaya ki Ganjam, Gajapati, Kandhamal pichhle mahine Cyclone Arnab aur floods jhel chuke the. Evacuation ek din ka kaam hai, recovery mahinon ka. Odisha ne hawa ko haraa diya. Ab dekhna hai compensation ki file hawa se tez chalti hai ya nahi.
Siddharth isko 'sanskaar' bolenge. Main isko budget line bolti hoon. Aur sach kahoon toh, aaj dono sahi hain.

scripts.topic: Magnet scheme: chaar LoIs, paanch slots, aur ek missing jawab

segments.line: Coal India ab magnet banayegi. Haan, wahi Coal India. Aur incentive maanga? Zero.
[GRAPHIC: FACT BOX] 19 November: Coal India, Prozeal, ReNew, Midwest ko ₹7,280-crore rare-earth magnet scheme ke LoIs. Target 6,000 tonne saalana. Global sintered magnet production ka 94% China mein.

Pehle facts. Economic Times ke mutabik Coal India ne koi per-kg incentive nahi maanga. Prozeal, ReNew aur Midwest ne ₹243 se ₹505 per kg maanga. Ek aur consortium, IRP Infratech aur BaRupOn, ne bhi zero maanga tha, par LoI list mein uska naam nahi. Kyun? Ministry ne bataya nahi. [GRAPHIC: '5 slots, 4 LoIs'] Scheme mein paanch beneficiaries ka plan tha, LoIs mile chaar. Who pays? ₹6,450 crore ka sales incentive, yaani aapka tax. China pe dependence kam karna zaroori hai, isme koi bahas nahi. Bas selection ka logic public kar dijiye. Magnet ka kaam hai cheezein kheenchna. Thodi transparency bhi kheench lijiye.
Siddharth isko 'Aatmanirbhar ka chumbak' bolenge. Chumbak achha hai, bas tender ka compass bhi dikha dijiye.
Aaj kaun jeeta, Reema ya Siddharth? App mein vote kariye. Good night, aur apni EMI check kar lijiye.

scripts.topic: Supply chain hathiyaar hai, aur trigger kiske haath mein?

segments.line: Supply chain bhi ab hathiyaar hai. Yeh main nahi, External Affairs Minister keh rahe hain.

[GRAPHIC: FACT BOX] 19 November, Tokyo: chautha India–Japan 2+2. Jaishankar ne supply chains aur market shares ke 'weaponise' hone pe chetaya. Japan ki forces pehli baar Indian ranges pe live-fire training karengi.

Pehle facts. Rajnath Singh ne kaha dono desh 'niche underwater and missile technologies' mein cooperation tez karenge. Diplomacy ke hisaab se solid din, yeh maanna padega. Ab same din ke do headlines dekhiye. [GRAPHIC: split screen — Tokyo | Delhi] Tokyo: supply chains weaponise ho rahi hain. Delhi: PM industry se pooch rahe hain ki Gandhi ke zamane se swadeshi kyun nahi hua. Aur sarkari data kehta hai India ke magnet imports ka 85 se 90% China se aata hai. Toh jo chain weaponise ho rahi hai, uska trigger humare haath mein nahi hai. Japan se dosti zaroori hai. Ghar mein factory usse bhi zyada.
Siddharth isko 'puraani dosti' kahenge. Dosti badhiya hai, par dost ke bharose apni factory nahi chalti.
Aaj kaun jeeta, Reema ya Siddharth? App mein vote kariye. Good night, aur apni EMI check kar lijiye.

scripts.topic: Gandhi ji ki 1930 wali chitthi, aur India Inc ka 'seen' tick

segments.line:
[SFX: halki si sitar ki dhun]

Aadab, namaskar. Main Siddharth, aur yeh hai The Late Edit. Aaj Prime Minister FICCI gaye, us sanstha mein jo agle saal sau baras ki ho rahi hai, aur bole ki 1930 mein Gandhi ji ne bhi aapse yahi kaha tha. Yaani India Inc ko ek message 96 saal pehle mila, aur status aaj bhi 'seen' hai. Meri daadi kehti thi, 'Beta, jo ek baar mein na sune, use doosri chitthi likho.' Pehle tathya, phir tark.

[GRAPHIC: FACT BOX — Sources: The Hindu, The Hindu BusinessLine, The New Indian Express]

Teen tathya. Pehla: 19 November ko New Delhi mein FICCI ke centenary AGM mein PM Modi ne poocha ki base corporate tax 30% se 22% hone aur ₹12 lakh tak ki income tax-free hone ke baad, kya companies ne salaries ya hiring badhayi. Doosra: unhone kaha 140 crore Indians ko 'assured market' na samjhein, jahan 'export quality' se kam kuch bhi bik jaaye, aur poocha ki naye FTAs ka faayda uthane ki yojana kahan hai. Teesra: unhone industry ko 'my true friends' kehkar reforms ke sujhaav maange; aur 20 November ko Congress ne kaha ki PM 'outgoing PM' banne ke khayal se 'rattled' hain.

[GRAPHIC: rewind — sepia film grain]

Chaliye, itihaas ke panne palatte hain.

1930, kam se kam Prime Minister ke shabdon mein. Unhone kaha, 'In 1930, Gandhi came to you and said exactly this.' Swadeshi, aatmanirbharta. [PROP: Siddharth ek purani peeli chitthi nikaalte hain, upar likha hai 'SWADESHI — URGENT'] Yeh rahi woh chitthi. Dekhte hain ise kisne padha.

24 July 1991. Manmohan Singh ji ka budget, aur licence-permit raj ki zanjeerein dheeli padti hain. Udyog ko khula aasmaan milta hai. Jo factory pehle ek permit ke liye saalon intezaar karti thi, ab bazaar se seedhe baat kar sakti thi. Daadi kehti thi, 'Pinjra khule toh panchhi udta hai. Bas ghonsla yahin banaye.' [chitthi pe stamp: 'DELIVERED']

2001–02. Gujarat ke naye Chief Minister ke roop mein Modi ji income tax officers ke ek jalse mein poochte hain, 'When will you stop treating everyone like a thief?' Yeh kissa unhone aaj khud sunaya. Matlab wealth creators ke samman ki baat unke liye nayi nahi hai.

August 2013. Morgan Stanley humein 'Fragile Five' mein ginta hai. Aaj PM ne garv se kaha ki hum wahan se fastest-growing major economy tak aaye. Garv jaayaz hai.

25 September 2014. Make in India. Lakshya: manufacturing ka GDP mein hissa 25%, 2022 tak. Ab imaandaari se: woh lakshya poora nahi hua, aur sarkaar ko bhi apna homework dobara dekhna chahiye. [stamp: 'SEEN']

20 September 2019. Goa mein Nirmala Sitharaman ji ne base corporate tax 30% se 22% kiya, naye manufacturing units ke liye 15%. Sarkaar ne apni taraf se daal mein ghee daal diya. Haan, yeh bhi maanna padega ki naukri ki koi shart nahi rakhi gayi thi. Sarkaar ne bharosa kiya ki bazaar khud karega. [stamp: 'SEEN']

11 November 2020. 10 sectors ke liye ₹1.46 lakh crore ka PLI; kul milaakar 14 sectors, ₹1.97 lakh crore. Electronics mein iska asar dikha bhi. [stamp: 'SEEN']

1 February 2025. ₹12 lakh tak ki income par koi income tax nahi. Middle class ke haath mein paisa, yaani demand ka beej.

Aur 19 November 2026. FICCI, jo 1927 mein bani thi, apna centenary convention karti hai. Pradhan Mantri wahi chitthi lekar wapas jaate hain aur poochte hain, 'Is this your success or your failure?' [stamp: 'SEEN' — chitthi ab stamps se bhar chuki hai] 96 saal, ek chitthi, aur reply abhi bhi 'typing...'

[GRAPHIC: OFFICIAL CLAIM vs DATA]

Sarkaar ka daava: humne apna kaam kiya. Tax kam, GST kam, aur Prime Minister ke mutabik jo refunds pehle aath mahine lete the, ab ek hafte mein aate hain. World Bank report ka hawala dekar unhone kaha ki 12–13 saal mein 50 crore log garibi se bahar aaye.

Ab data. [GRAPHIC: BAR CHART — 2023-24: corporate profits +22.3%, employment +1.5% | Source: Economic Survey 2024-25, via The New Indian Express]

Yeh chart kisi Opposition party ka nahi, sarkaar ke apne Economic Survey 2024-25 ka hai. 2023-24 mein India Inc ka munaafa 15 saal ke shikhar par tha, 22.3% badha. Rozgaar? 1.5%. Aur statistics ministry ke data ke mutabik regular salaried worker ki kamaai saal ka lagbhag 3.5% badhi, jab inflation average 4.9% thi.

Isiliye Prime Minister ne kaha, 'Your appetite is so enormous that no matter how much you are given, it is never enough.' Main udyog ka samarthak hoon. Wealth creators ka samman hona chahiye, aur PM ne bhi yahi kaha. Lekin samman do-tarfa hota hai. Jo karmachari machine chalata hai, uski tankhwah bhi us samman ka hissa hai. PM ne khud kaha ki koi desh tab aage badhta hai jab woh apne kisaanon, chhote udyamiyon, udyog, wealth creators aur taxpayers ka samman kare, subah-shaam gaali dekar nahi. Woh samman factory ke gate ke andar bhi pahunchna chahiye.

Prabhavit kaun? Salaried parivaar, chhote supplier, aur woh grahak jise 'export quality' sunkar laga ki ghar ke liye doosre darje ka maal chalega.

Congress ne kaha Prime Minister 'rattled' hain. Jairam Ramesh ne yahan tak kaha ki 'jhola' uthane se pehle woh doosron ko badnaam kar rahe hain. Rajneeti apni jagah. Par jab sarkaar aur Opposition dono ek hi chart ki taraf ishara karein, toh shayad chart sach bol raha hai.

REEMA: Siddharth, aap kehte hain sarkaar ne apna kaam kar diya. Lekin 25% manufacturing ka target sarkaar ka tha, industry ka nahi. Aur PIB ke hi data mein woh 2023-24 mein 17.5% pe hai.

SIDDHARTH: Maanta hoon, Reema ji. Lakshya bade the, nateeje chhote. Lekin tax cut ke baad bhi agar munaafa naukri mein nahi badla, toh yeh sawaal boardroom se hai.

REEMA: Boardroom se bhi, aur us policy se bhi jisne tax cut ko kisi job condition se joda hi nahi.

SIDDHARTH: Aap har shart ko kanoon banana chahti hain. Bazaar par thoda bharosa kijiye.

REEMA: Bharosa kiya tha. 2019 mein. Receipt abhi tak nahi aayi.

SIDDHARTH: [hanste hue] Aapke paas har cheez ki receipt hoti hai.

REEMA: Isiliye toh meri EMI kabhi bounce nahi hoti.

SIDDHARTH: Ek baat pe hum ek hain: quality. 140 crore log 'export quality' se kam ke haqdaar nahi.

REEMA: Agreed. Aaj ka sabse achha sentence wahi tha.

[GRAPHIC: 'AAGE KA RAASTA']

Toh aage kya?

Udyog ke liye: Prime Minister ne kaha ki agle 20 saal ke har long-term investment decision ki neenv 'India First' ho. Main ismein ek shabd jodunga: India First, aur Indian worker bhi first. Agar tax mein raahat mili hai, toh woh appraisal season mein bhi dikhni chahiye.

Doosra, quality. Swadeshi ka matlab sasta maal nahi. Jo cheez videsh bhejte ho, wahi Jhansi aur Jorhat ko bhi bhejo.

Teesra, FTA ka homework. Jab darwaze khule hain, toh dehleez par khade rehna sabse bada nuksaan hai. FICCI jaisi sansthaon ko chhote udyogon ki standards, certification aur distribution mein madad karni chahiye. Yahi sau saal ki asli virasat hogi. PM ne kheti aur allied sectors mein bhaari nivesh ka bhi aagrah kiya, jahan rozgaar ki sabse zyada zaroorat hai.

Aur sarkaar ke liye bhi: PLI textiles aur food processing jaise labour-intensive sectors mein dheema chal raha hai. Kachche maal ki keemat aur eligibility ki shartein suljhaiye.

Aap kya karein? Swadeshi kharidiye, par quality par samjhauta mat kijiye. Shikayat bhi kijiye, review bhi likhiye. Agar aap udyami hain, toh dekhiye kaunsa FTA aapke product ke liye darwaza khol raha hai.

Kya dekhein? Aane wala Budget, aur yeh ki FICCI aur doosre chambers PM ke 'true friends' wale nimantran ka jawab wage aur hiring ke commitment se dete hain, ya sirf maangon ki list se.

[PROP: woh peeli chitthi, ab stamps se bhari hui]

Toh yeh rahi 1930 ki chitthi. Delivered. Seen. Seen. Seen. Aaj Prime Minister ne ise phir forward kiya, is baar 'true friends' wale group mein. [Siddharth jeb se ek naya stamp nikaalte hain: 'REPLIED'] Yeh stamp main sambhaal ke rakhunga. Jis din kisi badi company ki annual report mein munaafe ke saath-saath tankhwah aur naukriyon ka graph bhi utna hi chadhega, us din yeh lagega. Aur pehli photocopy daadi ko jaayegi. Unhone is reply ka intezaar mujhse bhi zyada kiya hai.

Daadi kehti thi, 'Jo dost sirf maangne aaye, woh mehmaan hai. Jo kuch dekar jaaye, wahi dost hai.'

Aaj kaun jeeta? App mein vote kariye. Shubh ratri.

scripts.topic: Pyaas se pehle kuan: Odisha ki cyclone tayyari

segments.line: Toofan abhi samundar mein tha, aur Odisha ne pehle hi bistar-bastaa baandh liya tha.
[GRAPHIC: FACT BOX] Cyclone Akvan: 20 November, Gopalpur ke paas landfall forecast, 90–100 kmph hawa. Odisha ne 1 lakh+ log shift kiye. Landfall ke baad badi damage ya maut report nahi hui.

Pehle tathya, phir tark. Muhavara hai, 'Pyaas lagne pe kuan khodna.' Odisha ne ulta kiya. Reservoir pehle khaali kiye, ghat roads barricade kiye, anti-snake venom tak pehle se rakha, schools band kiye, aur har district ko ₹1 crore diya. Chief Minister Mohan Charan Majhi ne 'zero casualty' ka target rakha, aur BJD ke Naveen Patnaik ne logon se administration ke saath cooperate karne ki appeal ki. Sarkaar badli, sanstha nahi badli. Yahi institution ki taakat hai. [beat] Haan, ek kami. NIE ke mutabik yeh sab 24 din mein teesre cyclone ke liye karna pada. Prakriti ki deadline Delhi ki files se tez chalti hai.
Reema chart laayengi ki recovery ka bill kaun bharega. Sawaal jaayaz hai. Bas aaj ek taali Odisha ke liye bhi banti hai.
Aapki raay mein aaj kaun jeeta, Reema ya main? App mein vote kariye. Shubh ratri.

scripts.topic: Apna haath, jagannath: magnet ab desh mein banega

segments.line: EV ki motor ka dil, yaani magnet, ab tak China se aata tha. Ab?
[GRAPHIC: FACT BOX] 19 November: Coal India, Prozeal, ReNew, Midwest ko ₹7,280-crore rare-earth magnet scheme ke LoIs. Target 6,000 tonne saalana. Global sintered magnet production ka 94% China mein.

Pehle tathya, phir tark. Sarkari data ke mutabik 2022-23 se 2024-25 tak India ke permanent-magnet imports ka 84.8 se 90.4% China se aaya. April 2025 mein China ne export curbs lagaye, aur sabko yaad aaya ki fridge ke magnet se zyada zaroori motor ka magnet hai. Daadi kehti thi, 'Apna haath, jagannath.' Saath mein ₹3,435 crore ka e-bus payment-security portal bhi aaya, taaki 38,000 se zyada buses chalane wale operators ko time pe paisa mile. Ab imtihaan execution ka hai: plant lagane ke liye do saal. Humare yahan do saal mein toh kai flyover ka shilanyas-patthar bhi nahi hilta.
Reema poochengi, 'Who pays?' Abhi taxpayer. Par China pe nirbharta ki keemat bhi aakhir taxpayer hi chukaata.
Aapki raay mein aaj kaun jeeta, Reema ya main? App mein vote kariye. Shubh ratri.
Pehli baar Japan ki forces India mein live-fire training karengi. Haan, pehli baar.

[GRAPHIC: FACT BOX] 19 November, Tokyo: chautha India–Japan 2+2. Jaishankar ne supply chains aur market shares ke 'weaponise' hone pe chetaya. Japan ki forces pehli baar Indian ranges pe live-fire training karengi.

Pehle tathya, phir tark. Rajnath Singh aur Shinjiro Koizumi ki is saal yeh teesri defence ministers' meeting thi. Naara hai 'Design with Japan, Make in India'. Ship-repair arrangement, mine countermeasures, underwater aur missile technology, sab agenda par. Aur 2027 mein dono deshon ke rishton ke 75 saal. Daadi kehti thi, 'Purana dost aur purana ghee, dono waqt pe kaam aate hain.' Jaishankar ne kaha, 'old assumptions may no longer hold true.' Duniya badal rahi hai, aur aise mein bharosemand dost hi asli poonji hai. Haan, 'Design with Japan' sunkar thoda chubhta bhi hai. Design bhi hum khud karte, toh baat kuch aur hoti.
Reema ise 'weaponised headline' bolengi. Main kahunga: jab duniya hathiyaar uthaaye, toh dost chunna bhi strategy hai.
Aapki raay mein aaj kaun jeeta, Reema ya main? App mein vote kariye. Shubh ratri.

notes: Sourcing: all four leads checked out; no swaps. EPISODE: Modi's quotes are given in English as The Hindu, BusinessLine, India Today and NIE reported them. He probably spoke in Hindi, so lines like 'Modi ji, you do it, we'll watch' are the outlets' translations. NIE renders the same line as 'we will see'. The 1930 Gandhi reference is Modi's own claim, and the script attributes it to him. FICCI's founding in 1927 and the 24 July 1991 budget are well-established public history and do not come from today's sources. Manufacturing share now uses PIB figures (17.2% of total GVA in 2013-14, 17.5% in 2023-24, constant prices). The salary (₹16,538 to ₹21,103, about 3.5% a year vs 4.9% inflation) and profit/employment (22.3% vs 1.5%) figures are as the NIE editorial quoted them from MoSPI (Oct 2025) and Economic Survey 2024-25. The PLI employment figure (9.5 lakh+ by Aug 2024) is from a Lok Sabha answer. Comparing it with Make in India's 10 crore jobs goal is Reema's editorial framing; the two are not formally the same target. The 'Your feedback is valuable... write openly' line on Reema's envelope is a comedy prop that echoes Modi's 'write to me openly' remark. It is not a quote. CYCLONE: evacuation figures rose through the day. Indian Express (9:49am) said nearly 50,000, The Hindu (afternoon) said 1 lakh+, and a Firstpost search snippet put it at 2,98,676 by Thursday evening (the page returned 403 and the figure is not used in the script). The fact box uses the morning and afternoon figures. The 20 Nov landfall and no-major-damage update (NIE, Down To Earth) appears with hindsight. The '24 days, third cyclone' line is from NIE. The Cyclone Arnab reference is Naveen Patnaik's statement via PTI in the IE live blog. No jokes about victims. MAGNETS: the zero-incentive bids, the ₹243–505/kg asks and the absent IRP–BaRupOn consortium are from ET. The four-vs-five beneficiaries point is in both BusinessLine and ET. India's 84.8–90.4% magnet import share from China is government data cited by BusinessLine. The April 2025 Chinese export curbs are from ET. JAPAN: both PIB pages (PRID 2338701 and 2338564) returned 403 to direct fetch. The 'third Defence Ministers' Meeting this year' detail comes from the PIB search snippet; the other details are from India Today, The Hindu and the Japan MoFA release. Concessions and self-digs: Reema concedes on PLI in electronics, Odisha's capacity and the diplomacy. Siddharth admits the 25% target was missed and says the government should check its own homework, plus the 'Design with Japan' and flyover self-digs.
